title: Anisotropic Friedel oscillations and isoperimetric transport in two-dimensional free lattice Fermi seas
summary: Two physical consequences of the recent topological classification of 2d Fermi seas for free particles based on flat orbifolds $\mathbb{R}^2/Γ$ of discrete symmetry $Γ$, are explored. The first is a study of the spatial density behavior inside the mesoscopic window enclosed by the Fermi and (infinite) thermal lengths.
